messages:
maya: Rolling up Lynx9b bring-up checklist — please review. Target deploy path: hosted -> dedicated canary -> private on-prem smoke. TL;DR: int8 quant perf looks good, int4 still noisy. Need sign-offs: QA acceptance, security review, canary routing policy, fallback model.

samir: quick note — int8 latency on p4d looks 22% faster than baseline; cost 0.6x. int4 reduces cost further but hallucination on long-context tests.

olivia: added perf numbers to the eval dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evals/lynx9b

cj: For canary splitting suggest 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 24h windows, with rollback on >2% NRR or >3x latency p95.

maya: Proposed smoke tests: generation correctness on 100 prompts, embedding similarity spot checks, kv cache warmup test. Code snippet for smoke runner:

```bash
python infra/evals/run_smoke.py --model lynx9b-int8 --prompts smoke_prompts.json --timeout 60
```

zach: security: need KMS key rotation check and ensure no external model downloads on private. Also confirm HSM path for Private customers.

olivia: quality regression thresholds: Rouge-L drop <1.5, instruction-following BLEU delta <2, plagiarism checks pass. If threshold breached, auto-fallback to raven-13b.

maya: Routing policy draft:
- hosted: route to lynx9b-int8; fallback to lynx9b-int8-slow (quant fallback) or raven-13b
- dedicated: allow lynx9b-int8 + burst to lynx9b-fp16
- private: only allow pinned model versions; require offline approval

samir: Observability: need per-route token cost, p95 latency, error rate, model quality score. Alerting on quality requires eval harness integrated with console.

olivia: I'll own the canary metrics dashboard and baseline comparisons. Can someone own rollback runbook?

cj: I'll own rollback and runbook; will add playbook to eng-ml docs and link here.

deploy-bot: Canary gate created: lynx9b-canary-1765432100, initial 1% on hosted. Monitor window 2h.

maya: thanks everyone. Action items: olivia (dashboard), samir (perf final), zach (security check), cj (rollback runbook). We'll reconvene in 3 hours for go/no-go.

samir: noted, will post perf microbench in 45m.

olivia: LGTM on thresholds. :white_check_mark:

zach: security checks green for hosted/dedicated; private needs manual KMS confirmation per customer.

cj: rollback runbook added: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/lynx9b-rollback

maya: Go/no-go in 3h — I'll ping again.
